description: Adopt and build AI systems: readiness assessment, use-case triage, rollout and acceptable-use policy, plus agent loop design, subagent orchestration, spend budgets, agent security review, eval harnesses, and AI-usage reporting.

first-value.starter-task: Find out whether a team is ready to adopt AI tools, and what blocks it first
first-value.starter-prompt: Are we ready for AI? Our support team has 12 people on Zendesk, no AI tools today, and a legal team worried about customer data.
first-value.verification: ai-readiness-assessment scores six dimensions (data, tooling, skills, governance, process, culture) with evidence for each, and ranks the gaps that block adoption first.
first-value.recovery: If ai-readiness-assessment does not activate, ask for it by name and check that its folder exists in your skills folder (`~/.claude/skills/` by default).

journey.when: A team wants to adopt AI tools and needs to know whether it is ready, where to start, what the rules are, and how to roll out.
you_bring: the team or organisation in scope and what the answer will feed (a go/no-go, a budget, a sequence)
evidence about current tools, data, policies and practices
any regulatory or contractual limits on data

steps.you_do: Describe the team, its tools and data, and the concerns already raised.
steps.you_get: Scores from 0 to 4 on data, tooling, skills, governance, process and culture, each with an evidence line, the gaps ranked by what blocks first, and a one-sentence posture.
steps.decide: Decide whether to go ahead, and at what scope, from the stated posture.

steps.you_get: A ranked portfolio scored on value, feasibility and risk with the weights shown, one first slice with the observable that proves or kills it, and a not-yet list with promotion conditions.

steps.you_do: Give the population, the tools and any data rules already in force.
steps.you_get: An acceptable-use policy with three data tiers, permitted and prohibited uses as behaviours, a human-review matrix, approved tools with an exception route, and an owner per section.

steps.you_do: Name the chosen tool or workflow and who it is for.
steps.you_get: A rollout in waves with enablement per cohort, named champions, a comms plan that says what will not change, and an adoption gate on every wave.
steps.decide: Each wave's gate must be met before the next cohort opens.

journey.you_end_with: A readiness baseline, a chosen first use case, a usage policy, and a gated rollout plan.
